The Pre-Primary School day options are:

- **07:00 – 13:00** (standard day)
- **07:00 – 15:00** (with aftercare)
- **07:00 – 17:00** (with extended aftercare)

The school office is open 07:00 – 15:30 on weekdays if you need any further assistance 😊

- **07:00 – 13:00** (standard day)
- **07:00 – 17:00** (with aftercare)
